meanings.en: the quality of being impolite or offensive
meanings.exampleEn: His rudeness to the waiter embarrassed everyone at the table.
meanings.exampleTr: Garsona karşı kabalığı masadaki herkesi utandırdı.

meanings.en: rude or impolite behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: Ignoring the guests was an act of pure discourtesy.
meanings.exampleTr: Misafirleri görmezden gelmek tam bir nezaketsizlikti.

meanings.en: a weak or cowardly person
meanings.exampleEn: Don't be such a wimp; just ask her to dance.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kadar ödlek olma; sadece onu dansa kaldır.

meanings.en: a break or crack, especially in a bone
meanings.exampleEn: The X-ray revealed a fracture in her left wrist.
meanings.exampleTr: Röntgen, sol bileğinde bir kırık olduğunu gösterdi.

meanings.en: a skilled worker who makes things by hand
meanings.exampleEn: The bread was baked by a local artisan using traditional methods.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekmek, geleneksel yöntemler kullanan yerel bir zanaatkâr tarafından pişirildi.

meanings.en: to move slowly and quietly
meanings.exampleEn: She tried to creep upstairs without waking the baby.
meanings.exampleTr: Bebeği uyandırmadan üst kata sessizce çıkmaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: a small line or fold in skin or fabric
meanings.exampleEn: A deep wrinkle had formed between his eyebrows.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaşlarının arasında derin bir kırışıklık oluşmuştu.

meanings.en: in a creative way that shows imagination
meanings.exampleEn: The room was imaginatively decorated with recycled materials.
meanings.exampleTr: Oda, geri dönüştürülmüş malzemelerle yaratıcı bir şekilde dekore edilmişti.

meanings.en: in an original and creative way
meanings.exampleEn: He solved the problem inventively with materials at hand.
meanings.exampleTr: Problemi elindeki malzemelerle yaratıcı bir şekilde çözdü.

meanings.en: in a bad-tempered or annoyed way
meanings.exampleEn: "Leave me alone," he said irritably.
meanings.exampleTr: "Beni rahat bırak," dedi sinirli bir şekilde.

meanings.en: in a savage or extremely harsh way
meanings.exampleEn: The prisoners were brutally treated by the guards.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkumlar, gardiyanlar tarafından vahşice muamele gördü.

meanings.en: in a severe or unkind way
meanings.exampleEn: The critics judged his first novel rather harshly.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştirmenler ilk romanını oldukça sert bir şekilde değerlendirdi.

meanings.en: the quality of being severe or unkind
meanings.exampleEn: The harshness of the winter killed many crops.
meanings.exampleTr: Kışın sertliği birçok ürünü mahvetti.

meanings.en: the most intense or exciting point of something
meanings.exampleEn: The chase scene is the climax of the film.
meanings.exampleTr: Kovalamaca sahnesi filmin doruk noktasıdır.

meanings.en: a long curling lock of hair
meanings.exampleEn: The little girl had golden ringlets framing her face.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük kızın yüzünü çevreleyen altın sarısı bukleleri vardı.

meanings.en: a helpful piece of advice or an indicator
meanings.exampleEn: The coach gave me a few pointers on improving my serve.
meanings.exampleTr: Antrenör servisimi geliştirmem için bana birkaç ipucu verdi.

meanings.en: a place where people pay to use computers and the internet
meanings.exampleEn: We printed our tickets at an internet cafe near the station.
meanings.exampleTr: Biletlerimizi istasyon yakınındaki bir internet kafede yazdırdık.

meanings.tr: çevrim içi okul, uzaktan eğitim okulu
meanings.en: a school where lessons take place over the internet
meanings.exampleEn: During the pandemic, many children attended an online school.
meanings.exampleTr: Pandemi sırasında birçok çocuk çevrim içi okula gitti.

meanings.en: a person who rides a motorcycle or bicycle
meanings.exampleEn: A group of bikers roared past us on the highway.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir grup motorcu otoyolda yanımızdan gürültüyle geçti.

meanings.en: to mend a hole in clothing by sewing
meanings.exampleEn: My grandmother used to darn our socks by the fire.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyükannem çoraplarımızı şöminenin yanında örerek onarırdı.

meanings.en: to squeeze skin tightly between finger and thumb
meanings.exampleEn: She pinched my arm to make sure I was awake.
meanings.exampleTr: Uyanık olduğumdan emin olmak için kolumu çimdikledi.

meanings.en: things that are known to be true
meanings.exampleEn: Before deciding, we need to gather all the facts.
meanings.exampleTr: Karar vermeden önce tüm gerçekleri toplamamız gerekiyor.

meanings.en: the period of darkness between evening and morning
meanings.exampleEn: The desert gets very cold at nighttime.
meanings.exampleTr: Çöl gece vakti çok soğur.

meanings.en: existing by legal right or according to law
meanings.exampleEn: He was the de jure ruler, though others held real power.
meanings.exampleTr: O hukuken hükümdardı, ancak gerçek güç başkalarının elindeydi.

meanings.en: to decay or break down naturally
meanings.exampleEn: The fallen apples began to rot in the orchard.
meanings.exampleTr: Düşen elmalar meyve bahçesinde çürümeye başladı.

meanings.en: to decay and break down into smaller parts
meanings.exampleEn: Leaves decompose and enrich the soil over time.
meanings.exampleTr: Yapraklar zamanla çürür ve toprağı zenginleştirir.

meanings.en: offensive or improper, especially morally
meanings.exampleEn: He was arrested for indecent behaviour in public.
meanings.exampleTr: Kamuya açık yerde uygunsuz davranıştan tutuklandı.

meanings.en: settling a matter beyond doubt
meanings.exampleEn: The DNA test provided conclusive proof of his innocence.
meanings.exampleTr: DNA testi, masumiyetinin kesin kanıtını sundu.

meanings.en: determined and firm in purpose
meanings.exampleEn: She remained resolute despite all the criticism.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm eleştirilere rağmen kararlı kaldı.

meanings.en: unable to make decisions quickly
meanings.exampleEn: He is so indecisive that choosing a meal takes ages.
meanings.exampleTr: O kadar kararsız ki yemek seçmesi çok uzun sürüyor.

meanings.en: slow to act or speak because of uncertainty
meanings.exampleEn: She was hesitant to accept the new job offer.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni iş teklifini kabul etmekte tereddütlüydü.

meanings.en: in the process of decaying
meanings.exampleEn: A smell of rotting vegetables filled the kitchen.
meanings.exampleTr: Mutfağı çürüyen sebze kokusu sardı.

meanings.en: a decoration that makes something more attractive
meanings.exampleEn: The simple dress needed no further adornment.
meanings.exampleTr: Sade elbisenin başka süse ihtiyacı yoktu.

meanings.en: used as a decoration rather than for use
meanings.exampleEn: They planted ornamental shrubs along the path.
meanings.exampleTr: Patika boyunca süs amaçlı çalılar diktiler.

meanings.en: very great, deep, or intense
meanings.exampleEn: Her words had a profound effect on the audience.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözlerinin dinleyiciler üzerinde derin bir etkisi oldu.

meanings.en: the planting of trees to restore a forest
meanings.exampleEn: Reforestation projects help fight climate change.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeniden ağaçlandırma projeleri iklim değişikliğiyle mücadeleye yardımcı olur.

meanings.en: to refuse to follow rules or orders
meanings.exampleEn: The soldier was punished for disobeying orders.
meanings.exampleTr: Asker, emirlere itaat etmediği için cezalandırıldı.

meanings.en: to act in accordance with rules or requests
meanings.exampleEn: All staff must comply with the safety regulations.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm personel güvenlik kurallarına uymak zorundadır.

meanings.en: to lower in quality, value, or dignity
meanings.exampleEn: Such cruel comments only degrade the speaker.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu tür acımasız yorumlar yalnızca konuşmacının itibarını düşürür.

meanings.en: on purpose; intentionally
meanings.exampleEn: He purposely arrived late to avoid the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantıdan kaçmak için kasten geç geldi.

meanings.en: elegance, or an improvement in something
meanings.exampleEn: A few refinements made the design much cleaner.
meanings.exampleTr: Birkaç iyileştirme tasarımı çok daha temiz hale getirdi.

meanings.en: rudeness, or a rough texture
meanings.exampleEn: The coarseness of his jokes offended the guests.
meanings.exampleTr: Şakalarının kabalığı misafirleri rahatsız etti.

meanings.en: not requiring much effort or attention
meanings.exampleEn: After a hard week, she wanted an undemanding book to read.
meanings.exampleTr: Zorlu bir haftadan sonra okumak için fazla çaba gerektirmeyen bir kitap istedi.

meanings.en: to destroy a building completely, to the ground
meanings.exampleEn: The old factory was razed to make way for flats.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski fabrika, apartmanlara yer açmak için yerle bir edildi.

meanings.en: small and neatly fitted into a little space
meanings.exampleEn: The compact kitchen had everything we needed.
meanings.exampleTr: Sıkışık mutfakta ihtiyacımız olan her şey vardı.

meanings.en: in a thinly distributed or scarce way
meanings.exampleEn: The region is sparsely populated.
meanings.exampleTr: Bölge seyrek olarak nüfuslanmıştır.

meanings.en: the person ranking just below the leader
meanings.exampleEn: As second-in-command, she ran the office when the boss was away.
meanings.exampleTr: İkinci adam olarak, patron yokken ofisi o yönetiyordu.

meanings.en: to become lower or decrease
meanings.exampleEn: Prices usually go down after the holidays.
meanings.exampleTr: Fiyatlar genellikle tatillerden sonra düşer.

meanings.en: to go up or move to a higher position
meanings.exampleEn: The balloon slowly ascended into the clear sky.
meanings.exampleTr: Balon yavaşça açık gökyüzüne yükseldi.

meanings.en: sold under a well-known brand name
meanings.exampleEn: Branded trainers cost much more than generic ones.
meanings.exampleTr: Markalı spor ayakkabılar markasız olanlardan çok daha pahalıdır.

meanings.en: not having a brand name; general
meanings.exampleEn: The pharmacy offered a cheaper generic version of the drug.
meanings.exampleTr: Eczane ilacın daha ucuz jenerik versiyonunu sundu.

meanings.en: not wanted or approved of
meanings.exampleEn: The medicine may have some undesirable side effects.
meanings.exampleTr: İlacın bazı istenmeyen yan etkileri olabilir.

meanings.en: a lack of hope, warmth, or cheer
meanings.exampleEn: The bleakness of the moor matched her mood.
meanings.exampleTr: Bozkırın kasveti onun ruh haliyle örtüşüyordu.

meanings.en: the quality of being distant and unfriendly
meanings.exampleEn: His aloofness made it hard to get to know him.
meanings.exampleTr: Mesafeliliği, onu tanımayı zorlaştırıyordu.

meanings.en: unable to decide what to do
meanings.exampleEn: He stood irresolute at the crossroads, unsure which way to turn.
meanings.exampleTr: Hangi yöne döneceğinden emin olmadan kavşakta kararsız durdu.

meanings.en: newly appearing or developing
meanings.exampleEn: Investors are interested in emerging markets.
meanings.exampleTr: Yatırımcılar gelişmekte olan pazarlarla ilgileniyor.

meanings.en: an evil person, or someone very keen on something
meanings.exampleEn: He's a fitness fiend who runs ten miles a day.
meanings.exampleTr: Günde on mil koşan bir fitness tutkunu.

meanings.en: devoted to a task or purpose
meanings.exampleEn: She is a dedicated teacher who stays late to help students.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrencilere yardım etmek için geç saatlere kadar kalan, kendini işine adamış bir öğretmen.

meanings.en: difficulty in emptying the bowels
meanings.exampleEn: Eating more fibre can help relieve constipation.
meanings.exampleTr: Daha fazla lif tüketmek kabızlığı gidermeye yardımcı olabilir.

meanings.en: a ruler with absolute, often cruel, power
meanings.exampleEn: The country suffered for decades under a brutal despot.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülke, onlarca yıl acımasız bir despotun yönetimi altında acı çekti.

meanings.en: a person who believes in democracy
meanings.exampleEn: As a true democrat, she respected every citizen's vote.
meanings.exampleTr: Gerçek bir demokrat olarak, her vatandaşın oyuna saygı duyuyordu.

meanings.en: to give greater dignity or nobility to
meanings.exampleEn: Suffering can sometimes ennoble the human spirit.
meanings.exampleTr: Acı bazen insan ruhunu yüceltebilir.

meanings.en: to lower someone's dignity or status
meanings.exampleEn: He would never demean himself by begging.
meanings.exampleTr: Dilenerek kendini asla küçük düşürmezdi.

meanings.en: a state of uncertainty over a difficult choice
meanings.exampleEn: I'm in a quandary about whether to accept the offer.
meanings.exampleTr: Teklifi kabul edip etmeme konusunda bir ikilem içindeyim.

meanings.en: to dip food briefly into a liquid
meanings.exampleEn: He likes to dunk biscuits in his tea.
meanings.exampleTr: Bisküvileri çayına banmayı sever.

meanings.en: disappearing or becoming very rare
meanings.exampleEn: Tigers are among the world's vanishing species.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaplanlar, dünyanın yok olan türleri arasındadır.

meanings.en: a supporter of a belief, party, or person
meanings.exampleEn: The theory still has many adherents today.
meanings.exampleTr: Teorinin bugün hâlâ birçok taraftarı var.

meanings.en: the ability to control your emotions and behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: It took great self-control not to shout back.
meanings.exampleTr: Bağırarak karşılık vermemek büyük bir öz denetim gerektirdi.

meanings.en: to disconnect a device from a power supply
meanings.exampleEn: Remember to unplug the iron before you leave.
meanings.exampleTr: Çıkmadan önce ütünün fişini çekmeyi unutma.

meanings.en: to weaken something gradually
meanings.exampleEn: Constant criticism can undermine a child's confidence.
meanings.exampleTr: Sürekli eleştiri bir çocuğun özgüvenini baltalayabilir.
